cross_references.label: ERISA Congressional Findings and Purpose
cross_references.note: § 1132 enforcement mechanism gives effect to § 1001 congressional intent to protect pension rights of workers

cross_references.label: Liability for Breach of Fiduciary Duty
cross_references.note: § 1132(a)(2) authorizes civil action for relief under § 1109; fiduciary breach + enforcement are paired statutes

cross_references.label: ERISA Statute of Limitations
cross_references.note: Three-year SOL from actual knowledge of breach; six-year SOL from last act of breach; fraudulent concealment tolls

cross_references.label: Claims Procedure
cross_references.note: § 1133 requires plan to provide adequate claims procedure; failure excuses § 1132 exhaustion requirement

cross_references.label: ERISA Claims Procedure Regulation
cross_references.note: Minimum standards for claims and appeals; violation by administrator excuses participant from exhaustion before filing § 1132 suit

cross_references.label: Federal Identity Theft
cross_references.note: Fraudulent retirement election filed using participant's SSN and identifying information without authorization is § 1028(a)(7) aggravated identity theft; parallel criminal referral to FBI and DOL-OIG

cross_references.label: Plan Reporting and Disclosure
cross_references.note: § 1132(c)(1) $110/day penalty is triggered by failure to produce documents required under § 1021; Summary Plan Description and plan document are primary demand targets
